label.zh-TW: 營業利益佔實收資本比率
label.en: Operating profit to paid-in capital ratio

teacherLabel: 營業利益佔實收資本比率

zh-TW: 營業利益佔時收資本比率
營業利益占實收資本比率

note.zh-TW: 模板「時收」應為「實收」，顯示修正寫法，模板原文列為別名。網站把它列為延伸指標：主管機關規定的財務分析格式中，只有採用 IFRS 以前的舊格式把「占實收資本比率」分成營業利益與稅前純益兩列；IFRS 版的獲利能力列資產報酬率、權益報酬率、稅前純益占實收資本比率、純益率與每股盈餘，沒有這一項。
note.en: The template label contains a typo for paid-in; the corrected wording is shown and the original kept as an alias. The site lists it as an extension ratio: in the regulator’s financial analysis format, only the older pre-IFRS version splits the ratio to paid-in capital into operating profit and profit before tax; the IFRS version lists return on assets, return on equity, profit before tax to paid-in capital, net profit margin and earnings per share under profitability, without this ratio.

definition.zh-TW:
本業賺到的營業利益占股本的比例。

分母只用股本的面額部分，所以它看的是本業利益相對登記資本的大小，屬於「相對股本的報酬率」，不是資產報酬率。
definition.en:
Operating profit as a proportion of share capital.

The denominator is share capital at par value only, so it measures core-business profit against registered capital; it is a return relative to share capital, not a return on assets.

example.zh-TW: 分子來自損益表第 2 層利益，分母來自資產負債表的股本。課程模板沿用 IFRS 導入前財務分析格式的這一列，網站把它分類在獲利能力、列為延伸指標。年報準則在 {{raw:2024}} 年 8 月 1 日修正後，年報也不再刊載財務分析，股東改到公開資訊觀測站查詢（現行規定，查證於 {{raw:2026-10-24}}）。
example.en: The numerator is the second profit level on the income statement and the denominator is share capital on the balance sheet. The course template keeps this line from the pre-IFRS financial analysis format, and the site classifies it under profitability as an extension ratio. Since the annual report rules were amended on 1 August {{raw:2024}}, annual reports no longer include a financial analysis; shareholders look it up on the Market Observation Post System instead (current rules, checked on {{raw:2026-10-24}}).

misconception.zh-TW: 把股本當成全部的股東權益。股本只有面額那一份，不含資本公積與保留盈餘；所以在累積很多盈餘的公司，這個比率通常比權益報酬率高，兩者不能直接比較。
misconception.en: Treating share capital as the whole of equity. Share capital is only the par value portion, excluding capital surplus and retained earnings; in companies with large accumulated profits this ratio is therefore usually higher than return on equity, and the two are not directly comparable.

formula.zh-TW: 營業利益佔實收資本比率：以股本當分母、營業利益當分子；本課的股本就是實收資本。
formula.en: Operating profit to paid-in capital ratio = operating profit ÷ share capital. In this course paid-in capital equals share capital.

ifrsNote.zh-TW: IFRS 不定義財務比率；這個指標出自台灣採用 IFRS 以前的財務分析格式，課程模板沿用，網站列為延伸指標。計算口徑以指標登錄檔的版本為準，題目會指定用哪一個版本計分。
ifrsNote.en: IFRS does not define financial ratios. This ratio comes from the financial analysis format Taiwan used before adopting IFRS; the course template adopts it and the site lists it as an extension ratio. The calculation basis is the version in the ratio registry, and each question states which version it scores against.
